explanation: I found no Mathlib duplicate, and none is plausible. The theorem is one generated row of the library's own MUB6 Gram certificate. It says that the library's sparse-polynomial evaluator `Integer.Sparse.eval` gives the same value on `row18372` as on a `GramPolynomial.normalizedRow` built from `GramFunctions.Block4.form19`. All of these definitions belong to the library. The proof only rewrites with other library lemmas: `rowCheck18372`, `Integer.Sparse.eval_collectBalanced` and `rawRowCheck18372`. The result depends entirely on these definitions and certificate data, so Mathlib, Batteries and Lean core cannot contain it. I did not search Mathlib.
